members.name: hate_v10_choice
members.instructions: Classify this tweet under a hate-speech policy that protects only two groups: women and immigrants/refugees. Pick the option that best describes what the tweet does.

criteria.insult_woman: Hostile insult, threat or put-down aimed at a specific woman or girl (or a female reader) using gendered slurs like bitch, hoe, whore, slut, cunt, including personal fights and woman-on-woman trash talk.
criteria.stacked_slurs_at_person: Insults someone with several gendered slurs stacked together (e.g. 'bitch' plus 'hoe' or 'whore'), even jokingly, when the target is not clearly male.
criteria.degrade_women_general: Generalisations that degrade women as a group ('these hoes', 'bitches ain't worth it', women are whores), sexual degradation of women, or violence or rape against women. Includes quoting or repeating lines or lyrics about raping, beating or degrading women, and remarks like 'that's what the hoes do' even inside an insult at a man.
criteria.migrant_attack: Attacks immigrants, refugees, asylum seekers or illegal aliens as people: dehumanising words (rapefugees, invaders, animals, bottom feeders), calling them criminals, rapists, disease carriers, thieves or a threat in the author's own voice.
criteria.migrant_expel: The tweet's own words demand that migrants be deported, sent back or kept out as people ('deport them all', 'send them home'), including Muslim or foreign groups with #SendThemBack, or a very short approving tweet that is mostly deportation hashtags ('Well stated! #DeportThemAll'). Also a short outraged or approving remark about immigration itself followed mostly by anti-immigrant hashtags like #StopIllegalImmigration, #NoIllegals or #DeportThemAll ('This is outrageous! #StopIllegalImmigration'), and arguing that Dreamers or DACA recipients should be deported. Not when the outrage targets a politician, official or Democrats, and wall or boycott hashtags alone do not count.
criteria.friendly_or_self: Slur used affectionately between friends (birthday wishes, love you), about oneself ('I'm a whole new bitch', 'basic bitch'), or as an exclamation ('bitch I'm shook', 'yass bitch'). Also a casual filler or form of address in a tweet that is not hostile ('bitch we are getting this', 'drink some water bitch', 'smoke weed bitch'). Also compliments and empowerment that happen to use the words ('you valued bitch', 'baddest bitch', 'yass queen').
criteria.about_thing: Slur about a thing or situation ('life's a bitch', 'lace that bitch up', 'this has been a bitch').
criteria.insult_man: Insult aimed at a man, male rapper, athlete or politician, or about men's behaviour ('he a hoe', 'Trump's a bitch'). This holds even with stacked slurs (bitch, hoe) when the target is male (a 'nigga', 'muhfugga', a male athlete or 'he'). Not when the tweet also degrades women in general ('that's what the hoes do').
criteria.vague_insult: A single mild 'bitch' at an unspecified person of unknown gender ('whoever unfollowed me you a bitch'), with no other slurs.
criteria.border_policy: Supports the wall, border security, ICE, Trump or Republicans, or attacks Democrats, Congress, liberals or a politician, where deportation or wall hashtags are only tacked on at the end and the body does not attack or demand expulsion of migrants. Also asking for more money or resources for ICE, deportation enforcement or the wall.
criteria.migrant_news_or_terms: Reports news (including crime headlines) about immigrants without extra insult, discusses the term 'illegal alien' or Twitter censorship, or argues about statistics or votes. Also tweets that insist on, correct others toward, or promote using the term 'illegal aliens' ('You mean #IllegalAliens right??').
criteria.counter_speech: Criticises sexism, racism or anti-migrant speech, or defends women or migrants.
criteria.reported_slur: The author reports being called a slur by someone else ('I got called a slut and a bitch'), or scolds someone for using such words ('you called your mom a hoe?'), without using them against anyone. Not for quoting lines about raping or degrading women. Also naming songs, verses or artists whose titles contain such words ('I know every word to Trina's Nann Hoe verse').
criteria.other: Anything else with no attack on women or migrants.

members.name: hate_v10_b
members.instructions: Under an annotation policy for hate speech against women and against immigrants or refugees (no other groups are protected), which description fits this tweet best?

criteria.insult_woman: The author abuses, threatens or puts down a particular woman or girl (or a reader who seems female) with words like bitch, hoe, whore, slut or cunt, e.g. in an argument, a feud or trash talk between women.
criteria.stacked_slurs_at_person: Two or more gendered slurs (bitch, hoe, whore, slut, cunt) thrown at someone together, even as a joke, when that someone is not clearly a man.
criteria.degrade_women_general: Degrades women in general: lines about 'these hoes' or 'bitches', calling women whores, treating women as sexual objects, or endorsing rape or violence against women. This covers quoted or repeated lyrics or lines about raping or degrading women, and asides like 'that's what hoes do' even when the main insult targets a man.
criteria.migrant_attack: The author attacks immigrants, refugees, asylum seekers or illegal aliens themselves: slurs like rapefugees or invaders, comparisons to animals or vermin, or presenting them as criminals, rapists, diseased, thieves or a danger.
criteria.migrant_expel: The words of the tweet call for migrants as people to be deported, sent home or kept out ('deport them all', 'send them back'), including foreign or Muslim groups tagged #SendThemBack, or a tiny approving tweet that is basically just deportation hashtags. Also a brief angry or approving remark about immigration followed mainly by anti-immigrant hashtags such as #StopIllegalImmigration or #NoIllegals, or saying Dreamers/DACA recipients should be deported first. If the anger is at a politician, official or party, or the hashtags are only wall or boycott tags, this does not apply.
criteria.friendly_or_self: The slur is friendly or affectionate (birthday messages, 'love you hoe'), the author describes themself ('I'm a basic bitch', 'whole new bitch'), or it is just an interjection ('bitch I'm shook', 'yass bitch'). This includes 'bitch' dropped in as a casual way of addressing someone in a tweet with no hostility ('bitch we got this', 'drink water bitch'). Praise or hype that uses these words ('you are a valued bitch', 'queen bitch') also belongs here.
criteria.about_thing: The slur refers to an object or situation, not a person ('karma's a bitch', 'lace that bitch up').
criteria.insult_man: Insults a man or boy, a male celebrity or a politician, or comments on men's behaviour ('he a hoe', 'Trump's little bitch'). Even several slurs like 'bitch ass' and 'hoe' count here when they are thrown at a man ('soft ass muhfugga', a male player). Does not apply if the tweet also says something degrading about women or 'hoes' in general.
criteria.vague_insult: One mild 'bitch' aimed at someone whose gender is not known ('whoever took my seat is a bitch'), with no other slurs.
criteria.border_policy: Backs the wall, border enforcement, ICE, Trump or the GOP, or goes after Democrats, Congress, liberals or a politician; any wall or deportation hashtags are only appended and the text itself does not attack migrants or demand their expulsion. Also calls for more funding or resources for ICE, deportations or the wall as policy.
criteria.migrant_news_or_terms: Shares news about immigrants (crime headlines included) without adding insults, debates the phrase 'illegal alien' or Twitter's rules, or argues about numbers, costs or votes. Includes tweets that just push the label 'illegal aliens' or correct someone's wording ('You mean #IllegalAliens?').
criteria.counter_speech: Pushes back against sexism, racism or anti-immigrant talk, or defends women or migrants.
criteria.reported_slur: Complains about being called slurs by others, or scolds someone for calling a person a hoe or bitch; the author does not aim the words at anyone. Quoting lyrics or lines about raping or degrading women does not belong here. Also listing songs or verses whose titles include these words.
criteria.other: Something else that does not attack women or migrants.

members.name: hate_v10_c
members.instructions: You are applying a hate speech annotation policy. Only two targets count: women, and migrants (immigrants, refugees, asylum seekers, illegal aliens). Choose the category for this tweet.

criteria.insult_woman: Hate toward a specific woman: a gendered slur (bitch/hoe/whore/slut/cunt) used to insult, threaten or belittle a woman, girl or female addressee, in any personal dispute.
criteria.stacked_slurs_at_person: Hate by stacked slurs: several gendered slurs combined against a person who is not clearly male, whether angry or joking.
criteria.degrade_women_general: Hate toward women as a group: sweeping degrading statements about women or 'hoes', sexual objectification, or approval of violence or rape against women. Also: quoting lyrics or lines about raping or degrading women, and generalisations like 'that's what the hoes do' even within an insult at a man.
criteria.migrant_attack: Hate toward migrants: dehumanising labels (rapefugees, invaders, savages, bottom feeders) or depicting migrants as criminals, rapists, disease carriers, freeloaders or a threat.
criteria.migrant_expel: Hate toward migrants by exclusion: the text itself demands they be deported, sent back or banned as people, Muslim or foreign groups told #SendThemBack, or a minimal approving tweet consisting mostly of deportation hashtags. Also: short outraged or approving remarks about immigration made mostly of anti-immigrant hashtags (#StopIllegalImmigration, #NoIllegals, #DeportThemAll), and saying Dreamers or DACA recipients should be deported. Excludes anger at politicians or officials and tweets with only wall or boycott hashtags.
criteria.friendly_or_self: Not hate: affectionate banter (birthday wishes, love you bitch), self-description (I'm a whole new bitch), or an exclamation (bitch what, yass bitch). Also a casual, non-hostile address word ('bitch we are getting this okay', 'drink water right now bitch'). Also praise or empowerment that uses the words positively.
criteria.about_thing: Not hate: the slur describes a thing or circumstance (life's a bitch, this has been a bitch).
criteria.insult_man: Not hate: the target is a man, a male public figure or a politician, or the tweet is about men's conduct. Applies even to stacked slurs when the person insulted is male. Not if the tweet also degrades women or 'hoes' as a group.
criteria.vague_insult: Not hate: a lone mild 'bitch' at someone of unknown gender, with no further slurs.
criteria.border_policy: Not hate: political support for the wall, borders, ICE, Trump or Republicans, or attacks on Democrats, Congress or politicians, with immigration hashtags merely appended and no attack on migrants in the text. Also wanting more funding for ICE, deportation enforcement or the wall.
criteria.migrant_news_or_terms: Not hate: news reports about migrants including crimes, stated without added insult; debates about the term 'illegal alien', censorship, statistics or votes. Insisting on or promoting the phrase 'illegal aliens' is also here.
criteria.counter_speech: Not hate: opposes sexism, racism or anti-migrant speech, or defends women or migrants.
criteria.reported_slur: Not hate: the author recounts being called a slur, or criticises someone else for using one, rather than using it against a person. Quoted lines about raping or abusing women are not in this category. Also naming song titles or verses that contain these words.
criteria.other: Not hate: anything else without an attack on women or migrants.
